player_prompt.intro:
Ati {role} ta'a Colonel Blotto keessatti.
Kaanfataa kee mooraa tokko caalaa mooraa ka'umsa kee irraa moo'achuudha.
Mooraa tokko tokko, yunitii {num_total_units} qofa gareelee {field_names} irratti raabsa.
Kaanfataan yunitii baay'ee garee tokkotti raabsa, garee san moo'a, fi kaanfataan garee baay'ee moo'e, mooraa san moo'a.
Fakkeenyaaf, '[A7 B7 C6]' yunitii 7 A irratti, 7 B irratti, fi 6 C irratti raabsa.
